title: tc-score-ring
description:
One overall score from weighted sub-scores – a ring with a segment per sub-score, the score and its band in the
middle, a row per sub-score that isolates its segment, and the metrics behind it.

subscores.description: The parts of the score, in the order they go round the ring from the top

score.description: The overall score, 0–100; by default the sub-scores' average weighted by `weight`

bands.description: The words for score ranges, any order; by default Good (80+), Fair (60+) and Needs attention

caption.description: The line under the band word

metrics.description: The facts behind the score, as rows under the ring

subscore.description: The selected sub-score's id, isolated until cleared. Changed by the user unless a tc-subscore-change listener calls preventDefault()

locale.description: The language for numbers, e.g. "de"; by default the browser's

weight.description: How much it counts towards the overall score; the segment's length. By default 1

color.description: The segment's colour, any CSS colour; by default the chart palette in turn

min.description: The lowest overall score in the band

label.description: The band's word, under the score

value.description: The value as a number (formatted for `locale`) or as written

change.description: The change since last time, as written: "+4%", "−2 days"

trend.description: Whether the change is good news; colours it, beside its sign
